fillInstructions.description: Behind the removed Buzz silhouette, continue the central card’s smooth light gray-blue backdrop as a clean studio-like gradient with no strong texture. The fill should transition gently from slightly darker cool gray-blue near the top to brighter pale blue/white toward the lower-middle and bottom, matching the existing card background.
continueEdges: Extend the top-to-bottom gradient continuously through the entire removed character area.
Carry subtle left-to-right brightness variation so tones align with surrounding pixels at the character boundary.
Preserve the rounded-card border and interior anti-aliased edge exactly; only interior background behind Buzz is reconstructed.
Do not introduce new lines or shadows; maintain the same clean backdrop continuity.
fillInstructions.texture: Very smooth, low-noise, soft gradient with minimal texture and no visible pattern.
